description: This PHP script handles importing requirements into a test management system, supporting formats like CSV, XML, Doors CSV, and DocBook. It manages file uploads, XML parsing, requirement creation, and user interface initialization for requirement import functionality.

methods.name: doExecuteImport
methods.description: Handles the process of importing a requirement file, including file upload, XML validation, and invoking specific import functions based on format.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns an object containing request parameters and session data for the import process.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Creates and configures the GUI object used by Smarty templates for the import interface, based on scope and user permissions.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks user permissions for viewing and modifying requirements.

methods.name: doReqImportFromXML
methods.description: Imports requirements from an XML object, creating requirement or requirement specification entries.

methods.name: doReqImportOther
methods.description: Imports requirements from formats other than XML, using a mapping file.
